description_en: Registers an IoT data source group
kebab_example: aliyun ltl register-device-group --biz-api-version 1.0.0 --biz-chain-id 9811848178310000 --device-group-name '某数据源组' --product-key hKpHMh20000 --authorize-type ID2 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RegisterDeviceGroup

parameters.help_en: The API version number. Set the value to "1.0.0"
parameters.name: api_version

parameters.help_en: The ID of the business chain
parameters.name: biz_chain_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the IoT data source group.
The name must be 2 to 30 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), hyphens (-), periods (.), and parentheses (())
parameters.help_zh:
IoT数据源组名称。
长度为2~30字符，可以包含中文、英文字母、数字、下划线（_）、横线（-）、英文句号（.）和圆括号（()）
parameters.name: device_group_name

parameters.help_en: The ProductKey of the IoT data source group
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The authorization type.
ID2: Alibaba Cloud Link ID²
parameters.help_zh:
授权类型。
ID2：阿里云Link ID²
parameters.name: authorize_type

parameters.example: 某数据源组的备注信息。
parameters.help_en: The remarks. The value can be up to 100 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 备注信息。长度限制为100字符
parameters.name: remark

Data.description_en: The ID of the IoT data source group

Message.description_en: The error message returned if the call failed
Message.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息
Message.example: The system is busy. Please try again later.

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
